newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Zagrebacka applies for credit rating.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Zagrebacka applies for credit rating.

text.p: Zagrebacka Banka, Croatia's leading commercial bank, said on Thursday it had initiated procedures to obtain a credit rating with three international rating agencies.

"The final goal of this move is to secure more money and at a more favourable price for refinancing our activities," said chief executive Franjo Lukovic. He expected the bank to be rated within the "BBB" range, Lukovic added.
The bank named Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) as its adviser in talks with Moody's Investor Service, Standard & Poor's Corp and International Bank Credit Agency (IBCA).
The Croatian government recently asked the same three companies for sovereign ratings in a bid to improve its standing on international capital markets.

Zagrebacka is the country's only financial institution listed on the SEAQ international market, where its global depository receipts, representing one-tenth of a share, closed at $19.495 Wednesday. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
